# thinr

Binary image thinning (skeletonization) algorithms for R. Designed as a
drop-in replacement for `EBImage::thinImage()` with additional
algorithms behind a single dispatching function.

## Installation

``` r

# Once on CRAN:
# install.packages("thinr")

# From GitHub:
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("humanpred/thinr")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(thinr)

m <- matrix(0L, 11, 11)
m[3:9, 3:9] <- 1L      # 7x7 solid square

# Default: Zhang-Suen (matches EBImage::thinImage)
thin(m)

# Or pick an algorithm explicitly
thin(m, method = "guo_hall")

# Drop-in for EBImage::thinImage()
thinImage(m)
```

## Algorithms

| Method | Status (v0.2) | Notes |
|----|----|----|
| `zhang_suen` | Full | Default; matches `EBImage::thinImage()`. |
| `guo_hall` | Full | Slightly better diagonal-corner preservation. |
| `lee` | Full (2-D) | Four directional sub-iterations; crossing-number Euler-invariance. |
| `k3m` | Full | Six-phase lookup-table thinning; strongest corner preservation. |

See
[`vignette("choosing-a-method")`](https://humanpred.github.io/thinr/articles/choosing-a-method.md)
for guidance.

## License

LGPL-3. Chosen for drop-in compatibility with `EBImage` (which is LGPL)
so that `EBImage` can optionally depend on `thinr` and retire its
in-tree thinning code.
